```{r code-setup}
vals <- merge(ev$values[xpath %in% xp$xpath], sm, by = "xpath")
freq <- vals[, .(n = sum(n_filings)), by = .(value)][order(-n)]
top_codes <- head(freq$value, 7)
cy <- vals[, .(n = sum(n_filings)), by = .(tax_year, code = fifelse(value %in% top_codes, value, "Other"))]
cy[, share := n / sum(n), by = tax_year]
cy[, code := factor(code, levels = c(top_codes, "Other"))]
check_table(value_checks(xp, st, ev$values[xpath %in% xp$xpath], ev$shapes[xpath %in% xp$xpath], rtype, skip_year = partial_year(ev$filings)))
```

```{r code-plot, fig.height = 3.4}
if (nrow(cy)) {
  cols <- c(report_palette[seq_along(top_codes)], report_ink$other)
  names(cols) <- c(top_codes, "Other")
  p <- ggplot(cy, aes(tax_year, share, fill = code)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, colour = report_ink$surface, linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2009, 2024, 3)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
    labs(title = "Most common codes by tax year", subtitle = "Top 7 codes overall; everything else is 'Other'", x = NULL, y = "Share of filings") +
    theme_report()
  print(p)
  html_table(dcast(cy, tax_year ~ code, value.var = "n", fill = 0), caption = "Table view: filings by code and tax year", collapse = TRUE)
}
html_table(freq[, .(Code = value, Filings = n, Share = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * n / sum(n)))], caption = "Code frequencies (all xpaths, all years)", max_rows = 30)
checklist <- c(
  "Every code is valid for the list the form uses (state, country, valuation method, ...).",
  "The code list and its meaning did not change across schema versions.",
  "Codes are stored as text, so values like leading zeros are preserved."
)
```
